I activated the [On Play] effect on the played Digimon, deleted my opponent's Digimon ACE, and Overflow caused my opponent's memory to become 1. Can I then activate this card's
effect and play a Digimon card?

Effect: [Main] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Titan] trait Digimon are played, ＜Delay＞.
・If your opponent has 5 or more memory, you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Titan] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
